verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents its own receipt workflow: receipt and memo capture by upload through the mobile app, and automated emails that chase employees when a receipt or memo is missing after a card purchase. That workflow still depends on the employee capturing the receipt manually. Nothing in the evidence shows receipts being captured or transactions being coded automatically at the moment of card use. Missing for 10: automatic receipt matching at swipe time, automatic GL/category coding of card transactions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
